title: FuzzyDate
description: A date that admits how sure we are. Years are decimal (1944.43 ≈ 6 June 1944); negative = BCE. Rule: earliest ≤ best ≤ latest.

earliest.description: The earliest moment it could have happened (decimal year).

latest.description: The latest moment it could have happened (decimal year).

best.description: The single most likely moment. This is where it sits on the river.

precision.description: How finely the date is actually known.

method.description: How the date was worked out.

sources.description: Source ids backing this date: a file in data/sources/ (without .json), or "wikidata:Q123". Empty = not cited yet.
